scoring_justification: Power factor peak is recomputed from the agent's CSV; band structure pudding-mold verification uses structural dispersion criteria.

hidden_assets.purpose: Peak n-type power factor gold values for Ba2PdO3 and La4PdO7, and reference Bi2PdO4 peak for the 1e20 check.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 5(a) and text: Ba2PdO3 peak 1.48e12 W/(m·K^2·s) at 4.4e20 cm^-3; La4PdO7 peak 1.30e12; Bi2PdO4 peak 1.36e12.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported target values; they are inline in grading_spec.json to guarantee self-containment.

required.bands: array of objects (band_index, eigenvalues array of floats in eV)

outputs.description: Electronic band structure for La4PdO7. The checker verifies the pudding-mold band shape.
Thermoelectric power factor sigma*S^2/tau at 700 K as a function of carrier concentration. The checker extracts the maximum n-type value and compares to hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The screener filters that identified Ba2PdO3 and La4PdO7 are assumed as given; only the band structure and transport validation of these two compounds is reproduced. All scored artifacts must be produced under /app/outputs. The band structure JSON must include k-path points and eigenvalues; the CSV must contain the specified columns.
